question: Tina starts driving from point Y and drives 4 km north. Then, she turns left and drives 2 km, then turns left again and drives 6 km. She then turns left again and drives 4 km. Then, she turns right and drives 4 km. She then takes a final right turn and drives 2 km and stops at point 8. How far (minimum distance) and in which direction must he drive to reach point Y again? (Unless specified, all turns are 90-degree turns only.)
